    g=[r[:] for r in grid]

    mark=next(v for v in {v for row in grid for v in row} if v!=bg)

        js=[j for j,x in enumerate(grid[row]) if x==mark]

                if grid[row][j]==bg: g[row][j]=2
    return g
''')

p='programs/task-f352ee9f.py';open(p,'w').write('''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    bg=max({v for row in grid for v in row},key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    mark=next(v for v in {v for r in grid for v in r} if v!=bg)
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # rows connect consecutive markers
    for i in range(h):
        js=[j for j,x in enumerate(grid[i]) if x==mark]
        for a,b in zip(js,js[1:]):
            for j in range(a+1,b):
                if grid[i][j]==bg:g[i][j]=2
    # columns connect markers, but recolor only within the marked object's bounding region
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]==mark]
    r0=min(i for i,j in pts);r1=max(i for i,j in pts);c0=min(j for i,j in pts);c1=max(j for i,j in pts)
    for j in range(c0,c1+1):
        ii=[i for i in range(r0,r1+1) if grid[i][j]==mark]
        for a,b in zip(ii,ii[1:]):
            for i in range(a+1,b):
                if grid[i][j]==bg:g[i][j]=2
    return g
''')
